name: Barbara
notes: Both sources give her a pure healer build (Max HP; her Skill and Burst heal) and a damage build (Vaporize at KQM, Bloom with EM at Game8). The card follows the healer build, which both sources list and Game8 puts first. Neither source gives stat goals or ER, so goals are empty for the role's defaults. Game8 puts Ocean-Hued Clam first for the set; KQM calls Maiden Beloved best for healing and Ocean-Hued Clam the better farm. The same three weapons head both lists; KQM's order is used. Her damage build wants EM or ATK% Sands, a Hydro DMG Goblet and a crit Circlet with Wanderer's Troupe, which this card does not use.
